title: Arthur Rackham's illustrations for Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1907)
licence: Public domain (published 1907; Rackham died 1939, so out of copyright in the UK since 2010 and in the US as a pre-1931 publication).
notes: `caption` is the caption as printed: for colour plates, the "List of the Plates"; for drawings, the caption printed under the drawing. Most drawings have no printed caption (null). `alt` is the alt text in the Project Gutenberg file.

`chapter` is the chapter the illustration appears in (null for the frontispiece). Drawing 06 is labelled "Alice and the Dormouse" in the source, but it appears in chapter 3 where Alice talks to the Mouse; its file name says Mouse.

Colour plates and JPEG drawings are copied unchanged from the source; PNG drawings are flattened onto white and re-encoded as JPEG. Images are small (about 500 px on the long edge for plates), as in the source.
Anchors and the Illustration Pack definition are a later task (P1-LAY-06).
